messages.subject: plyr and plotting datetimes
parts:
I am new to R and ggplot (and programming in general) and am trying to
learn the ropes using a simple dataset that tracks the sleeping habits
of my newborn son (it records when he falls asleep and when he wakes
up). The idea is to calculate discrete sleep durations and create
plots based on total hours slept/day, average sleeping time, common
nap times, etc. I've included reference code and an example of the
dataset at the end of the message. I'm currently running R 2.9.2 and
the latest version of ggplot2.

Questions:

1) I've done some data manipulation but it seems to me I should be
able to do the same with less code using plyr. Unfortunately, I must
be missing something basic (I've looked through the documentation) and
can't seem to figure out how to use ddply and summarize to wrap
multiple steps into a single (or fewer) step(s). Can someone point me
in the right direction?

2) I can't seem to figure out how to plot dates/datetimes. I get the
error "Error in units == units[1L] : comparison of these types is not
implemented." I tried using scale_x_datetime(). I get the feeling I
must not be understanding fundamental about handling datetimes.

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Data:

> head(ethandata)
action_name action_value action_unit action_time
1 gnight NA 2009-10-21 01:40:11
2 gmorning NA 2009-10-21 01:15:40
3 gnight NA 2009-10-21 00:45:29
4 drank NA milk 2009-10-21 00:00:23
5 diaper NA 2009-10-20 22:30:37
6 drank NA milk 2009-10-20 22:30:29

> head(naps)
sleep gn day
1 30 mins 2009-10-21 00:45:29 2009-10-21
2 120 mins 2009-10-20 19:30:14 2009-10-20
3 26 mins 2009-10-20 17:10:17 2009-10-20
4 156 mins 2009-10-20 12:50:30 2009-10-20
5 217 mins 2009-10-20 08:06:22 2009-10-20
6 98 mins 2009-10-20 06:02:23 2009-10-20

Code:

ethandata <- read.csv("ethan2.txt", sep="\t", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
ethandata <- transform(ethandata,
                       day = as.Date(ethandata$action_time,
'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'),
                       hour =
as.POSIXct(ethandata$action_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))

ethan <- subset(ethandata,
                 action_name == "gnight" | action_name == "gmorning",
                 select = c(action_name, day, hour))

ethan.gnight <- subset(ethan, action_name == "gnight",
                       select = c(action_name, day, hour))
ethan.gmorning <- subset(ethandata, action_name == "gmorning",
                         select = c(action_name, day, hour))

if(ethan.gnight$hour[1]<ethan.gmorning$hour[1]){
    sleep <- round(ethan.gmorning$hour[1:length(ethan.gnight$hour)] -
ethan.gnight$hour)
} else
    sleep <- round(ethan.gmorning$hour[1:length(ethan.gnight$hour)-1]
- ethan.gnight$hour[-c(1)])

naps <- data.frame(sleep, gn = ethan.gnight$hour[-c(1)], day =
ethan.gnight$day[-c(1)])

qplot(gn, sleep, data=naps, geom="line") + scale_x_datetime()
